_comment: Cases whose extra cost is a deliberate design choice. A key matches every case whose name contains it. Each entry needs a reason and upper bounds (bytes, redis, redisWrites, sql, time) the new value must stay within. Cost limits are measured against f43854d on 2026-10-16. The two exact sync/int time limits document Johan's SipHash decision and the complete quiet-Mac PR133 confirmations; they do not accept other cases or widen the precision limit. Johan explicitly approved five exact HTTP time caps on 2026-10-17 (alternative 1); see docs/developer/design-performance-results.md. All other cost/time rules and the precision limit are unchanged.

DesignHttpWorkloadBenchmarks.Fresh(Backe.reason: Design spec 9.2: every HTTP L2 lookup reads the shared generation vector (global clear, URL slot, tags) before the representation, so invalidation by another node applies at once. Each component is a read-only Lua script on one key (cluster-safe), so 3 EVALSHA, each HMGET + TTL, pipelined in one round trip, then the entry HMGET. Nothing is written. The bytes are those scripts and the bounded transport (timeout and breaker) around both reads.

DesignHttpWorkloadBenchmarks.Miss(Backen.reason: Same generation vector as a fresh hit (3 EVALSHA, each HMGET + TTL). A miss in a URL slot nobody has used yet also creates that slot's epoch (HSET + PERSIST), a share that depends on how many new slots the run reaches.

DesignHttpWorkloadBenchmarks.Fresh(Backe.reason: Design spec 9.2: the generation vector is one parameterized SELECT without locks once the epochs exist, then the entry read, so still 2 commands per hit. The extra bytes are SqlClient's cost for that command with 4 parameters and the bounded transport around both reads.

KeepCookies=True).reason: Design spec 9.3: with KeepCookies the handler stays in the pipeline and bypasses the cache. f43854d had no KeepCookies, so its baseline runs without the handler. The bypass reads the request's Cache-Control for only-if-cached (48 B of request headers) and returns a completed Task (72 B).

GeneratedPrefixHitPathBenchmarks.SyncHit.reason: Johan accepted the approximately 8% sync/int cost of choosing process-keyed SipHash-1-3 over Marvin. The complete quiet Apple M5 PR133 reconfirmation (2b3cb93e4558d2b2c7a2cf36e8b9f0b8e422ec7f to 4f6cd7382a73c6964958c96b4e2c19537e111257, ten alternating pairs) measures +4.3%, 95% ratio interval 1.026-1.061. Accept at most 8% in this exact control. This does not waive GUID performance, allocation or I/O costs, or the 6% precision requirement.

The same deliberate SipHash-1-3 security choice. The complete quiet Apple M5 PR133 comparison (2b3cb93e4558d2b2c7a2cf36e8b9f0b8e422ec7f to 4f6cd7382a73c6964958c96b4e2c19537e111257, ten alternating pairs) measures +3.9%, 95% ratio interval 1.021-1.057. Accept at most 8% in this exact sync/int control, with no acceptance for other key/return/listener shapes or byte/command costs. The unchanged precision requirement still applies.

DesignHttpWorkloadBenchmarks.Miss(Backen.reason: Approved by Johan on 2026-10-17 (alternative 1): bounded aggregate cost of the shared local HTTP store, full storage metadata and conservative resident-byte accounting. The complete quiet-Mac comparison measures +5.1% (95%1.045–1.058). This is a conscious feature/cost tradeoff, not proof that every extra nanosecond comes from one field. No ordinary-hit,method-cache or native-L2 limit changes.

HttpResponsePathBenchmarks.Revalidated(L.reason: Approved by Johan on 2026-10-17 (alternative 1): bounded aggregate cost of enabled Core origin instrumentation and shared HTTP residency bookkeeping. Preserve request/load labels,duration/error records and activity parenting. Complete quiet-Mac measurement +4.1% (95%1.032–1.049). No no-listener revalidation or ordinary-hit limit changes.

Approved by Johan on 2026-10-17 (alternative 1): bounded aggregate cost of enabled Core origin instrumentation and shared HTTP residency bookkeeping after invalidation. Preserve duration/error labels,activity parenting and generation guarantees. Complete quiet-Mac measurement +6.7% (95%1.040–1.095). Bound is on the paired estimate; the unchanged6%precision check still applies first.

HttpColdMissBenchmarks.Miss(Listening=Fa.reason: Approved by Johan on 2026-10-17 (alternative 1): bounded aggregate cost of local HTTP publication after invalidation: shared TinyLFU storage,conservative byte/metadata accounting,URL-slot/custom indexes and direct physical administration. The implicit client index is already removed. Complete Nimbus confirmation +16.9% (95%1.148–1.190); original Mac interval remains wide and is retained. Only this exact case; no general cold-miss waiver or precision waiver.

HttpColdMissBenchmarks.Miss(Listening=Tr.reason: Approved by Johan on 2026-10-17 (alternative 1): bounded aggregate cost of local HTTP publication after invalidation with Core listeners: shared store,conservative byte/metadata accounting,URL-slot/custom indexes and direct physical administration. Complete Nimbus confirmation +17.3% (95%1.156–1.191). Only this exact case; original wide Mac result retained. Correctness,allocations/commands and precision remain required.
